Package app.swea2

Class SettingsController

java.lang.Object
app.swea2.SettingsController
class SettingsController extends Object
Controls the settings / profile-edit screen.

Implements the sequence diagram steps: openSettingsOption() → displayOptions() → user edits → Save → updateProfile() → updateUserSettings(data) → success: showSuccessMessage() → refreshProfile() / failure: showErrorMessage(String, String).
